name: crowdstrike-mcp
description: Every CrowdStrike Falcon MSP operation, plus a Flight-Control-aware local store that answers fleet-wide questions across all your tenants at once — something no other Falcon tool (including the official MCP server) does.

falcon_client_id.title: FALCON_CLIENT_ID
falcon_client_id.description: CrowdStrike API client ID (Falcon console > API Clients & Keys).

falcon_client_secret.title: FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET
falcon_client_secret.description: CrowdStrike API client secret. Shown once at client creation.

crowdstrike_oauth_scope.title: CROWDSTRIKE_OAUTH_SCOPE
crowdstrike_oauth_scope.description: Optional OAuth2 scope for the token request. Leave empty: CrowdStrike grants scopes to the API client in the Falcon console.

crowdstrike_base_url.title: CrowdStrike Falcon API base URL
crowdstrike_base_url.description: Base URL for the CrowdStrike Falcon API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

crowdstrike_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
crowdstrike_token_url.description: Optional. Leave blank: the client ID and secret are posted to /oauth2/token on the cloud named by the base URL. Set it only for a non-standard token endpoint.

crowdstrike_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
crowdstrike_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to credentials.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

crowdstrike_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
crowdstrike_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews and sends only when called again with confirm set to true). Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

crowdstrike_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
crowdstrike_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

crowdstrike_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
crowdstrike_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on CrowdStrike requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

crowdstrike_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
crowdstrike_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
